title: Latinus son of Telemathus
summary: Raleigh names Latinus son of Telemathus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The fourth Latinus in Pomponius Sabinus his count, the sonne of Telemathus. He is not Latinus the sonne of Faunus. The one-word title would fold onto latinus, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
